paragraphs: The Citan 112 uses the M282 - a 1.3-litre turbocharged petrol engine fitted from the current W420 generation onwards. It is part of a family of modern, efficient four-cylinder units used across the Mercedes-Benz range. No widely-reported engine issue for this variant - we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every CITAN 112 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the CITAN 112 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
